实例ID。

description.en:
The ID of the instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值：**1**。
description.en: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: **1**.

The number of entries per page. Valid values:

*   **30**
*   **50**
*   **100**

Default value: **30**.

title.zh: 查看数据倾斜的相关信息

descriptions.zh: 数据倾斜会影响数据库的运行速度，AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例提供了DescribeDBInstanceDataSkew接口帮助您查看实例的数据倾斜情况，便于您及时消除数据倾斜。
descriptions.en:
To prevent data skew from affecting your database service, you can call this operation to query the details about data skew on an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance.


## Limits

You can call this operation up to 1,000 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-db-instance-data-skew --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --database test --order-by Field:_TableSize,_Type:_Desc --region cn-hangzhou
